Typical hunting sim BUT a little bit different so yeah.
The most disappointing project of my 😭

QUICK TUTORIAL: (how to play) <- important!!!!!
 * How to earn money and hunt animals
   - firstly find an animal
   - when you kill it use your trusty knife to skin it
   - then stab (attack) the limbs with your knife to get the meat
 * You can learn more from the npcs in game. <- (The hunter in the forest town has help option)

(Game has mobile support but it's really hard to play)
Main PC Controls:
 - LMB - Shoot/Attack
 - RMB - Aim down sight
 - Tab = Inventory
 - Left Shift = Sprint
 - X = Drop
 - C = Crouch
 - Z = Laydown
 - M = Back to main menu
